title: Three cruise ports
note: Note: Mossel Bay's call counts differ by source (section 2.4). Schematic coastline, not to scale. Infrastructure Report, Jul 2026, p111.
conflicts: No conflict between IR p111 and v15 on the values printed (21 calls, about 13,000 passengers, R22m facility opened November 2025, 3 trial calls, no cruise berth or passenger facility).
The spec writes 'three trial calls'; v15 prints '3 trial calls' and the figure follows v15.

IR p111 values left off because v15 does not print them in this section: about 23 calls next season, the 8m entrance depth, the distances of about 110 km and 400 km. The 'about 40% use' figure is not printed.
lead_in: The three ports stand at different stages: one equipped homeport, one working day stop and one still on trial (Figure 2.20).
remarks: Cape Town's four status lines are not on IR p111; they are v15's (paragraph beginning 'Berth space is not the limit' and Table rows citing IR p111).
Tags 'Homeport', 'West coast' and 'East coast' and the two itinerary labels use v15's terms (paragraph beginning 'Ships come for the circuit').
